title: City of Boston issues warnings on storm-related sewage discharge
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Local News Officials are urging residents to stay out of affected waterways for at least 48 hours after several sewage discharges during Thursday night's rain.

Boston health officials are warning residents to avoid several local waterways after multiple sewage overflows sent wastewater into the Fort Point Channel, Charles River, and Boston Harbor during the Thanksgiving rain.

The Boston Public Health Commission issued a public health advisory Friday, after six reported discharges from Boston Water and Sewer Commission and Massachusetts Water Resources Authority (MWRA) facilities.
